response.message: Astra: Your carry-forward passage introduces “Attachment” and “不明-clear”; copying is now changing the language without changing the scene. Set synonym polishing aside. Read the chrysanthemum passage as a reader encountering it for the first time: where does the wording first interrupt your ability to picture her looking? Spend your next edit there rather than reproducing all three paragraphs. Judge the edit by what becomes easier to see, not by whether you can describe it as richer.
response.rationale: Redirects repetitive copying toward a bounded, reader-grounded edit of the same scene, with attention allocated to a visible textual obstacle.
